deductions.claim: The useful acting unit is an intention changing, not a label switching. Curious already stages antenna, gaze, head, then a sharing glance; Mischievous hides, peeks, withdraws and peeks again. These authored sequences offer a stronger personality foundation than adding amplitude.
Thinking now has one dominant chin mitten; Focused keeps two low hands; Grateful deliberately joins them. The inspected poses preserve distinct actions without bigger anatomy.
The hop correction removes the source-level descent stop while preserving the 17-unit lift. Frame evidence supports compact contact, but cannot certify landing weight or comic rhythm.

The overview supports broad affect more securely than exact labels: several closed-eye positive poses remain visually close. This is a reason to test useful contrasts, not proof of failure or a mandate to exaggerate every pose.
